name: @bernouy/cms-permissions
description: CMS roles & permissions — the `urn:cms:<feature>:<verb>` permission catalogue, role definitions with their grants (built-ins: admin / user / public-anon), the pure `can()` decision helper, AND the `RolesRepository` storage seam (in-memory at root, Mongo under `./mongo`). Vocabulary is dependency-free; assignment and enforcement live with their owners.
